messages:
sanjay: Quick async checkpoint — milestone 3 for the runtime perf sprint is TOMORROW. Need owners to ack and call out blockers so we can decide roll/hold.
alex: Ack. I'm owner for kernel PRs (prefetch/handshake). PR #4123 is staged, failing a couple infra tests — looking into flakies. ETA EOD if no surprises.
rachel: Ack. Owning KV warmup tuning + feature flag. Patch ready, needs canary deploy (dedicated nodes) to validate behavior under real traffic.
maria: I'll run the perf regression suite once we have a green image. Can someone push an image tag or share the CI artifact? Also will do cold-start/cold-cache runs.
alex: pushed image tag runtime-kernel:2026-03-16-gtk
ci-bot: build runtime-kernel:2026-03-16-gtk —  ✅ build passed, unit tests 118/120, 2 flaky failures recorded (timeout on test_cache_eviction)
ops: Created canary cluster kv-warmup-canary-7 in staging (3 nodes). Let me know the tag to deploy.
sanjay: @alex: can you re-run the failing infra tests (flaky) and add any extra logging if you can't repro locally? @rachel: can FF be toggled server-side so we can flip quickly if regressions show up?
rachel: Yes — adding feature flag kv_warmup_v2 behind remote-config. Will push flag config today.
maria: Running perf now against runtime-kernel:2026-03-16-gtk on canary nodes. Will do:

```bash
python infra/tools/perf_runner.py \
  --suite cold_start,steady_state \
  --nodes 3 \
  --image runtime-kernel:2026-03-16-gtk \
  --out /tmp/perf_kv_warmup.json
```

maria: Early numbers: steady-state token latency down ~8%, throughput +6%. Cold-start median still +18% vs baseline — looks like KV handshake not warming early enough.
alex: re: cold-start — I'm seeing a gap in the prefetch handshake when request arrives before KV client init finishes. Adding a lightweight synchronous prefetch handshake to avoid 1st-request spike, will try in a small test branch.
sanjay: OK. Decisions / next steps: (1) alex — finish infra flake fixes + small handshake change and get PR green; (2) rachel — deploy feature flag and config to canary cluster; (3) maria — finish full perf run and post numbers in this thread by EOD; (4) ops — stand by to roll to dedicated after we see perf stability. Ping here when each step done.
alex: noted — will ping once PR merged. If handshake patch doesn't fully eliminate cold-start bump, we fall back to FF off by default and iterate.
rachel: Feature flag config pushed: kv_warmup_v2=false default. Will also add quick toggle in console (ops can flip to true for canary cluster).
ops: Deployed runtime-kernel:2026-03-16-gtk to kv-warmup-canary-7 with FF enabled (kv_warmup_v2=true) for canary traffic. Monitoring logs/latency.
ci-bot: integration e2e against canary cluster —  ✅ 42/42 scenarios passed
maria: Full perf run complete. Summary: steady-state P50 down 7.9%, P95 down 4.2%. Cold-start P50 improved 9% vs previous, but still 9% worse than baseline. Uploading full results: /tmp/perf_kv_warmup.json
sanjay: Good progress. If cold-start still regress, we keep FF off by default and schedule a follow-up spike/root-cause session. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
deploy-bot: Scheduled canary rollback watch — auto-rollback window 2h starting 2026-03-16T18:00:00Z. Alerts to #eng-runtime and #incidents if thresholds hit.
alex: Merge completed for #4123 after infra fixes. CI green. Pushing prod candidate tomorrow after final sign-off.
sanjay: Perfect. Closing async check-in — we'll reconvene in tomorrow's stand for rollout decision.
